sky_class.caption: Existing new-sky test only; performance needs20 references per cell. Reference counts shown without a minimum; raw count is not sky density. Stratification exposes composition differences; residual patterns alone do not establish a spatial calibration error.

sky_source.caption: Existing new-sky test only; performance needs20 references per cell. Reference counts shown without a minimum; raw count is not sky density. Stratification exposes composition differences; residual patterns alone do not establish a spatial calibration error.

sky_brightness.caption: Existing new-sky test only; performance needs20 references per cell. Reference counts shown without a minimum; raw count is not sky density. Stratification exposes composition differences; residual patterns alone do not establish a spatial calibration error.

footprint.caption: Train/cal/test geometry and quarantined identities; cells may contain quarantined historical identities alongside a nonhistorical role. Counts concern assembled references, not the full optical sky. No unobserved cell is filled.

sky_density.caption: N divided by exact spherical cell area; this is reference selection density, not stellar population density.

kiel.caption: Published RVS parameters with original parameter-quality qualification. Fixed displayed Teff/logg limits and excluded counts. Other/transition is not assigned a definite evolutionary phase.

metallicity.caption: Continuous spectral trends use reliable RVS parameters, finite metallicity and positive formal metallicity error. Full scatter extents retained; fixed-bin medians/16–84% spread show occupied ranges, not causal metallicity corrections.

observing_conditions.caption: Fixed bins with N≥10; class labels retained separately. Bottom legends give actual reference N in every bin. Trends mix selection and measurement effects; sparse20–25 bins do not establish faint-star accuracy.

intervals.caption: All occupied cells show N; N<10 estimates blank. Width is in distance-modulus magnitudes. Large evolved-star misses remain visible despite the overall dwarf-dominated coverage.

gaia_flags.caption: Gaia PIT and log density read only from gaia_refined/matched_griz/evaluation.npz. Negative/weak parallaxes retained in observation space. Flat PIT is not proof of unbiased target-population calibration; support/ambiguity flags are assessed against actual errors.

pdf_examples_1.caption: Two deterministic, nonoverlapping identity-hash examples from each registered category. Full modulus support shown; densities integrate to1. Frozen grz/griz quantiles independently reproduced within1e-6. Reference uncertainty is shown; an ambiguity flag does not itself prove a distinct astrophysical branch.

pdf_examples_2.caption: Two deterministic, nonoverlapping identity-hash examples from each registered category. Full modulus support shown; densities integrate to1. Frozen grz/griz quantiles independently reproduced within1e-6. Reference uncertainty is shown; an ambiguity flag does not itself prove a distinct astrophysical branch.

paired_physics.caption: Exact same reference and identity in each pair. Symmetric-log y scale resolves small changes while retaining full extrema. Bands show dispersion of star-level changes, not bootstrap uncertainty. Validated bin counts and summaries saved separately.

paired_uncertainty.caption: 2000 paired bootstrap resamples of entire occupied10° test cells; star-weighted rate recomputed in every draw, percentile95% interval. Negative rate difference improves. Small cell counts and reference selection limit generalization; this is exploratory comparison, not an adoption test.

application_coverage.caption: Original26000 probability sample represents the old southern DECam parent only. Historical training is joined to the saved expanded_A legacy training identities; old/new unions are disjoint. New cal/test panels use the union of qualified class/distance rows. Each panel normalized separately. Fixed color-magnitude-bin absence is distinct from model support, and nonempty bins do not prove accuracy. W2 availability is independent of W1.

wise_joint.caption: Independent axes: WISEMASK!=0, FRACFLUX>=1 (or invalid), measured S/N<5. Finite positive IVAR, observations and transmission required. Negative flux belongs to low S/N. Fractions use original weights and entire-parent denominator; unmeasured fraction retained separately in statistics.
